slice: L4 device and assistive-tech acceptance matrix

matrix.rule: devices gate accepted only when 24/24 pass, or by an explicitly dated waiver; a failing cell reopens the gate; expired waivers block again

phase4Status.L3: transport + restore rehearsal proven; owner destination and platform PITR decision remain
phase4Status.L4: mechanism deployed; owner must record the 24 real device/AT results (or a dated waiver)
phase4Status.exit: launch-ready verdict still requires the owner to record content labelling/attestations and the real device results

openItems: Owner records the 24 device/assistive-tech cells with real evidence notes, or a dated waiver.
Owner replaces KINNSO_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL with their destination and confirms one test alert.
Owner decides backup/PITR: reinstate or dated waiver.
Owner signs off privacy/rollback/backup/accessibility and labels fixture content.
